title: FF-LN ScalarRamp (p=36,H=152,drop=0.05) + Adam(lr=9e-4), Clip=1.0 — 60min trials
abstract: H sweep under 60min timeout: reduce head width to H=152 (vs 160) at p=36, drop=0.05, Adam lr=9e−4, clip=1.0. MAE+curvature (λ=1e−4). Tests whether a slightly smaller head improves over −0.026269.
